description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'BaseAttributeType' which provides a common base implementation for attribute type classes in the OpenMRS project. It includes metadata annotations, field definitions related to attribute data types, occurrence constraints, and configuration settings, as well as getter and setter methods for these fields.

classes.name: BaseAttributeType
classes.description: An abstract base class for attribute types in OpenMRS, providing common properties such as occurrence constraints, datatype information, and handler configurations for derived attribute type classes.

methods.name: getMinOccurs
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of occurrences allowed for the attribute type.

methods.name: getMaxOccurs
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of occurrences allowed for the attribute type.

methods.name: getDatatypeClassname
methods.description: Returns the class name of the data type associated with this attribute type.

methods.name: getDatatypeConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration string for the data type.

methods.name: getPreferredHandlerClassname
methods.description: Returns the class name of the preferred handler for this attribute type.

methods.name: getHandlerConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration string for the handler.

methods.name: setMinOccurs
methods.description: Sets the minimum number of occurrences for the attribute type.

methods.name: setMaxOccurs
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of occurrences for the attribute type.

methods.name: setDatatypeClassname
methods.description: Sets the class name of the data type.

methods.name: setDatatypeConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration string for the data type.

methods.name: setPreferredHandlerClassname
methods.description: Sets the class name of the preferred handler.

methods.name: setHandlerConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration string for the handler.
